arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} Demonic Strength's bonuses are increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} and now persist after you leave {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}. Casting {c_important}Core{/c} or {c_important}Basic{/c} {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skills outside {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} consumes {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} Demonic Strength to cast them again at a random enemy.
